panels.title: Peer delta
Nb messages sent by Tcp clients

targets.expr:
100 *
sum by (server_name) (
  rate(tcp_server_message_error_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
)
/
clamp_min(
  sum by (server_name) (
    rate(tcp_server_message_received_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
  )
  +
  sum by (server_name) (
    rate(tcp_server_message_emitted_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
  )
  +
  sum by (server_name) (
    rate(tcp_server_message_error_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
  )
  +
  sum by (server_name) (
    rate(tcp_server_message_closed_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
  ),
  1e-9
)

100 *
sum by (server_name) (
  rate(tcp_server_message_closed_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
)
/
clamp_min(
  sum by (server_name) (
    rate(tcp_server_message_received_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
  )
  +
  sum by (server_name) (
    rate(tcp_server_message_emitted_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
  )
  +
  sum by (server_name) (
    rate(tcp_server_message_error_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
  )
  +
  sum by (server_name) (
    rate(tcp_server_message_closed_total{server_name=~"$server_name"}[$__rate_interval])
  ),
  1e-9
)
